title: Chatcryption
body:
E2EE for your Minecraft whispers.

By default, will only work on the Essentials(X) message system. (e.g.`[sender -> me]: message`)

## Configuration

The configuration file is `[minecraft directory]/config/chatcryption-config.json`

### Fields
- `message-commands`: the list of commands that are for messaging. Defaults to Essentials(X)/Vanilla ones.
- `reply-commands`: the list of commands that are for replying. Defaults to Essentials(X)/Vanilla ones.
- `split-message-send-interval-ms`: (default: `400`) the milliseconds to wait between sending each part of an encrypted message
- `request-public-key-comment`: what to include in the initial message, to explain it if the recipient doesn't have Chatcryption installed. 
- `message-command`: (default `msg`) the command to use to send messages
- `enabled` (default `true`): whether the mod will be enabled. Can be changed in-game with `/chatcryption [on|off]`

## Responsibility

It is your responsibility to use this appropriately. It is not my fault if you get in trouble for inconveniencing or annoying moderators. I am not liable for any punishments you may receive.

## Security

Please don't expect this to be actually super secure. It's probably good enough in most cases.
